title: Location of smoke alarms and smoke detectors.*
officialText:
On or after January 1, 2021, smoke alarms and smoke detectors installed or replaced in group R occupancies shall be installed in accordance with section 907.2.11.6 of the New York city building code.

(L.L. 2018/113, 6/9/2018, eff. 6/9/2018; Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022; Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
